name: mcp-server-insumer
description: MCP server for InsumerAPI: condition-based access infrastructure. Send a wallet and conditions, get a signed boolean across 37 chains. 27 tools: attestation, wallet trust profiles (145 base checks across 27 chains in 9 dimensions, up to 166 across 29 chains in 13 with optional Solana, XRPL, Bitcoin, Tron, Stellar, Sui wallets), compliance templates, ACP/UCP commerce, Merkle proofs, crypto key purchase (USDC/USDT/BTC/USDT-TRC20), instant API key setup. No balances exposed, no identity required.
author: Douglas Borthwick
